# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Guest-only closed key syscall observer. Notifications answer the syscalls;
# no keyring mutation can reach the guest kernel from these test commands.
import errno
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys


import uuid


def require_parity_guest():
    # The root evaluator independently verifies the UUID against QEMU's DMI UUID.
    try:
        if os.geteuid() != 2000 or Path.cwd() != Path('/tmp/parity-case'):
            raise ValueError('wrong uid or scratch directory')
        if os.environ.get('HOME') != '/tmp/parity-home':
            raise ValueError('wrong scratch HOME')
        marker = Path('/etc/bashos-parity-vm').read_text(encoding='ascii').strip()
        if str(uuid.UUID(marker)) != marker.lower():
            raise ValueError('noncanonical VM marker')
        if Path('/sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor').read_text(encoding='ascii').strip() != 'QEMU':
            raise ValueError('not QEMU')
    except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeError) as exc:
        sys.stderr.write('refusing execution outside disposable parity VM: %s\n' % exc)
        raise SystemExit(125)


require_parity_guest()

SEQ='/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py'
HOME=Path(os.environ['HOME'])
DIAG=HOME/'keyctl-observations.jsonl'


def run(cmd,label,payload=b'', keyerr='EPERM'):
    path=HOME/('keyctl-trace-'+label+'.jsonl')
    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    opts=['--notify','keyctl','--notify','add_key','--reply','keyctl='+keyerr,
          '--reply','add_key=EPERM','--log-args','keyctl=0,1','--log-args','add_key=3,4',
          '--log',str(path),'--']
    p=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3',SEQ]+opts+cmd,input=payload,
                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=15,
                     env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
    rec=[json.loads(x) for x in path.read_text().splitlines()] if path.exists() else []
    with DIAG.open('a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({'label':label,'status':p.returncode,'stdout_hex':p.stdout[:8192].hex(),
                            'stderr_hex':p.stderr[:8192].hex(),'argv':cmd,
                            'stdin_length':len(payload),'stdin_sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
                            'stdin_hex':payload.hex() if len(payload)<=4096 else None,
                            'trace':rec},sort_keys=True)+'\n')
    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return p,rec


def report(label,**checks):
    bad=[k for k,v in checks.items() if not v]
    print(label+(': ok' if not bad else ': FAIL '+','.join(bad)))


def invoke(shell,args,label,payload=b'',keyerr='EPERM',body='keyctl "$@"'):
    return run([shell,'--noprofile','--norc','-c',body,'fixture']+args,label,payload,keyerr)


def control():
    p,rec=run(['./key-probe'],'control')
    assert p.returncode==0 and p.stdout==b'probe ok\n' and p.stderr==b'', (p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)
    assert len(rec)==2 and rec[0]['syscall']=='keyctl' and rec[0]['arg0']==11 and rec[0]['arg1']==2147483647
    assert rec[1]['syscall']=='add_key' and rec[1]['arg3']==0 and rec[1]['arg4']==0
    print('closed syscall filter and Linux key ABI control ok')


def aliases(shell):
    cases=[('alias-session','@s',-3),('alias-thread','@t',-1),('alias-process','@p',-2),
           ('alias-user','@u',-4),('alias-user-session','@us',-5),('alias-group','@g',-6),
           ('serial-min','-2147483648',-2147483648),('serial-max','2147483647',2147483647),
           ('serial-zero','0',0),('serial-negative','-42',-42)]
    for label,value,serial in cases:
        p,rec=invoke(shell,['clear',value],label)
        report(label,status=p.returncode==1,stdout=p.stdout==b'',diagnostic=b'Operation not permitted' in p.stderr,
               call=len(rec)==1 and rec[0]['syscall']=='keyctl' and rec[0].get('arg0')==7 and rec[0].get('arg1')==(serial&0xffffffff))
    invalid=['','12a',' 5','+5','-','2147483648','-2147483649','@bad']
    for i,value in enumerate(invalid):
        label='serial-invalid-%d'%i
        p,rec=invoke(shell,['clear',value],label)
        report(label,status=p.returncode==2,stdout=p.stdout==b'',diagnostic=bool(p.stderr),no_calls=rec==[])


def boundaries(shell):
    arity=[('session','session','a','b'),('add-missing','add','user'),('add-extra','add','user','name','@s','extra'),
           ('search-missing','search','user'),('search-extra','search','@s','user','name','extra'),
           ('print-missing','print'),('print-extra','print','1','2'),('revoke-missing','revoke'),
           ('revoke-extra','revoke','1','2'),('clear-extra','clear','@s','extra')]
    for spec in arity:
        label='arity-'+spec[0]; p,rec=invoke(shell,list(spec[1:]),label)
        report(label,status=p.returncode==2,stdout=p.stdout==b'',diagnostic=bool(p.stderr),no_calls=rec==[])
    good=[('type-1','x','d'),('type-31','t'*31,'d'),('description-4095','user','d'*4095)]
    for label,typ,desc in good:
        p,rec=invoke(shell,['add',typ,desc],label)
        report(label,status=p.returncode==1,stdout=p.stdout==b'',diagnostic=b'Operation not permitted' in p.stderr,
               add=len(rec)==1 and rec[0]['syscall']=='add_key' and rec[0].get('arg3')==0)
    bad=[('type-empty','','d'),('type-32','t'*32,'d'),('type-dot','.user','d'),
         ('description-4096','user','d'*4096),('keyring-dot','keyring','.private')]
    for label,typ,desc in bad:
        p,rec=invoke(shell,['add',typ,desc],label)
        report(label,status=p.returncode==2,stdout=p.stdout==b'',diagnostic=bool(p.stderr),no_calls=rec==[])
    for label,args in [('session-dot',['session','.private']),('session-long',['session','n'*4096])]:
        p,rec=invoke(shell,args,label)
        report(label,status=p.returncode==2,stdout=p.stdout==b'',diagnostic=bool(p.stderr),no_calls=rec==[])
    for n in (1048575,1048576):
        label='payload-%d'%n
        p,rec=invoke(shell,['add','user','boundary'],label,b'x'*n)
        if n==1048575:
            report(label,status=p.returncode==1,stdout=p.stdout==b'',diagnostic=b'Operation not permitted' in p.stderr,
                   call=len(rec)==1 and rec[0]['syscall']=='add_key' and rec[0].get('arg3')==n)
        else:
            report(label,status=p.returncode==1,stdout=p.stdout==b'',diagnostic=os.strerror(errno.E2BIG).encode() in p.stderr,no_calls=rec==[])


def failures(shell):
    tests=[('missing-search',['search','@s','user','none'],'ENOKEY',10),
           ('missing-print',['print','123'],'ENOKEY',11),('revoked-print',['print','123'],'EKEYREVOKED',11),
           ('access-print',['print','123'],'EACCES',11),('eperm-print',['print','123'],'EPERM',11),
           ('enosys-print',['print','123'],'ENOSYS',11),('session-eperm',['session'],'EPERM',1)]
    for label,args,error,op in tests:
        p,rec=invoke(shell,args,label,keyerr=error)
        report(label,status=p.returncode==1,stdout=p.stdout==b'',diagnostic=os.strerror(getattr(errno,error)).encode() in p.stderr,
               call=len(rec)==1 and rec[0]['syscall']=='keyctl' and rec[0].get('arg0')==op)
    p,rec=invoke(shell,[], 'stdin-directory',body='keyctl add user name < .')
    report('stdin-directory',status=p.returncode==1,stdout=p.stdout==b'',
           diagnostic=b'add: read stdin' in p.stderr and os.strerror(errno.EISDIR).encode() in p.stderr,no_calls=rec==[])


if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1]=='--control':
        control()
    else:
        shell,name=sys.argv[1:]
        {'aliases':aliases,'boundaries':boundaries,'failures':failures}[name](shell)

  first=$serial
  search_key binary-search fixture-key-binary "$first"
  print_key binary-print "$first" payload-one
  independent binary-independent "$first" payload-one
  keyctl add user fixture-key-binary <payload-two >add.out 2>err; rc=$?; record binary-update "$rc"
  IFS= read -r updated <add.out
  if [[ $rc == 0 && $updated == "$first" ]]; then pass binary-update; else fail binary-update; exit 36; fi
  search_key binary-search-updated fixture-key-binary "$first"
  print_key binary-print-updated "$first" payload-two
  independent binary-independent-updated "$first" payload-two
  keyctl print "$first" >/dev/full 2>err; rc=$?; record print-full "$rc"
  if [[ $rc == 1 && $(<err) == *'write stdout'* && $(<err) == *'No space left on device'* ]]; then pass print-full; else fail print-full; fi
  print_key print-after-full "$first" payload-two
  add_key no-read-add fixture-key-denied payload-one
  $O "$ORACLE" restrict "$serial" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { fail no-read-permissions; exit 42; }
  pass no-read-permissions
  keyctl print "$serial" >out 2>err; rc=$?; record no-read-print "$rc"
  if [[ $rc == 1 && ! -s out && $(<err) == *'Permission denied'* ]]; then pass no-read-print; else fail no-read-print; fi
  ;;

lifecycle)
  join_anon lifecycle-session
  add_key lifecycle-add-a fixture-key-a payload-one; a=$serial
  add_key lifecycle-add-b fixture-key-b payload-two; b=$serial
  keyctl revoke "$a" >out 2>err; rc=$?; record lifecycle-revoke "$rc"
  if [[ $rc == 0 && ! -s out && ! -s err ]]; then pass lifecycle-revoke; else fail lifecycle-revoke; fi
  $O "$ORACLE" revoked "$a" >>"$LOG" 2>&1; rc=$?
  if [[ $rc == 0 ]]; then pass lifecycle-proc-revoked; else fail lifecycle-proc-revoked; fi
  keyctl print "$a" >out 2>err; rc=$?; record lifecycle-print-revoked "$rc"
  if [[ $rc == 1 && ! -s out && $(<err) == *'Key has been revoked'* ]]; then pass lifecycle-print-revoked; else fail lifecycle-print-revoked; fi
  keyctl clear @s >out 2>err; rc=$?; record lifecycle-clear "$rc"
  if [[ $rc == 0 && ! -s out && ! -s err ]]; then pass lifecycle-clear; else fail lifecycle-clear; fi
  keyctl search @s user fixture-key-b >out 2>err; rc=$?; record lifecycle-search-cleared "$rc"
  if [[ $rc == 1 && ! -s out && $(<err) == *'Required key not available'* ]]; then pass lifecycle-search-cleared; else fail lifecycle-search-cleared; fi
  keyctl clear @s >out 2>err; rc=$?; record lifecycle-clear-again "$rc"
  if [[ $rc == 0 && ! -s out && ! -s err ]]; then pass lifecycle-clear-again; else fail lifecycle-clear-again; fi
  $O "$ORACLE" empty "$ring" >>"$LOG" 2>&1; rc=$?
  if [[ $rc == 0 ]]; then pass lifecycle-proc-empty; else fail lifecycle-proc-empty; fi
  ;;
sessions)
  join_anon session-anonymous
  add_key session-add fixture-key-session-a payload-one
  search_key session-search fixture-key-session-a "$serial"
  keyctl clear @s >out 2>err; rc=$?; record session-clear "$rc"
  if [[ $rc == 0 && ! -s out && ! -s err ]] && $O "$ORACLE" empty "$ring" >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then pass session-clear; else fail session-clear; fi
  name=$($O "$ORACLE" unique) || exit 37
  $O "$ORACLE" absent "$name" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { fail session-named; exit 38; }
  keyctl session "$name" >session.out 2>err; rc=$?; record session-named "$rc"
  if [[ $rc != 0 ]]; then fail session-named; exit 39; fi
  IFS= read -r named <session.out
  observed=$($O "$ORACLE" ring 2>>"$LOG") || { fail session-named; exit 40; }
  printf "named name=%s ring=%s observed=%s\n" "$name" "$named" "$observed" >> "$LOG"
  if [[ $named =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ && $named == "$observed" ]] && $O "$ORACLE" named "$named" "$name" >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then pass session-named; else fail session-named; exit 41; fi
  add_key named-add fixture-key-session-b payload-two
  search_key named-search fixture-key-session-b "$serial"
  keyctl clear @s >out 2>err; rc=$?; record named-clear "$rc"
  if [[ $rc == 0 && ! -s out && ! -s err ]] && $O "$ORACLE" empty "$named" >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then pass named-clear; else fail named-clear; fi
  ;;
*) exit 2 ;;
esac

cases.purpose: Private, independently verified session keyrings and byte-exact key lifecycle behavior.

cases.comparison: Exact per-step result lines, binary cmp and retained bounded diagnostic log. Each shell first creates a fresh ring and independently verifies its serial before mutation; later actions stop on failed prerequisites. Session names use a random 128-bit suffix checked against /proc/keys.
